name: Sit-Down Lunch Roasted Chicken Breast Caesar Salad
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
whyItWorks: The sliced roasted chicken breast, croutons, and shaved aged Parmesan are great protein, while the raw romaine and lemon Caesar dressing need modification.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the warm roasted chicken breast, croutons, and shaved Parmesan (or ask for the chicken breast served over mashed potatoes instead of romaine).
watchOuts: Lemon juice and garlic in Caesar dressing
